chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

When you pray behind an Imam whom you follow, then do not recite behind him, whether you hear his recitation or do not hear, unless it is a prayer in which recitation is done aloud and you do not hear, then recite.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational salat
key_terms.تَأْتَمُّ: you follow in prayer as a congregant
key_terms.تَقْرَأْ: you recite the Qur'anic passage in prayer
key_terms.قِرَاءَتَهُ: his recitation, meaning the Imam's recitation

ai.seo_question: Should a person recite Qur'an while praying behind the Imam in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding recitation while praying behind an Imam. It states that the follower should not recite behind the Imam, whether he hears the recitation or not, except in an audible prayer when he does not hear the Imam's recitation, in which case he should recite.
